notes.title: ShoppingMall: Manager Simulator is Now Live! Grab Your Launch Discount Today!
notes.notes:
Dear Managers,
After months of development, hard work, and invaluable player feedback, we’re thrilled to finally release the full version of the game.

In ShoppingMall: Manager Simulator, you step into the shoes of a mall manager, where every choice you make shapes your retail empire. Design your mall, choose the right stores, manage customer needs, and tackle the challenges that come with running a successful shopping center. The journey to building the best mall in town is in your hands - will you rise to the challenge?

To show our appreciation for your support, we’re offering a special launch discount - but act fast, this offer is only available for a limited time! Don’t miss your chance to experience the game at an exclusive price.

Your feedback has been crucial in shaping this game, and we can’t wait to hear your thoughts on the full release. We encourage you to share your experiences with us, as your feedback will help us continue to improve the game and bring you even better updates in the future.

Thank you for being with us from the beginning, and happy shopping!
The ShoppingMall: Manager Simulator Team

notes.title: Only 1 Week Until Launch - ShoppingMall: Manager Simulator is Almost Here!
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, Managers![/b]

The countdown is on - [b]ShoppingMall: Manager Simulator[/b] is launching in just one week! After months of development and your invaluable feedback, we're finally ready to deliver the full experience.

To celebrate the upcoming release, we’re offering an [b]exclusive discount on launch day[/b]! It’s the perfect chance to step into the world of mall management at a special price. But hurry - this offer is available for a limited time only.

We can’t wait for you to experience the full game. Thank you for your support – the grand opening is almost here!

Happy shopping!
[b]The ShoppingMall: Manager Simulator Team[/b]

notes.title: Grab Your Early Access Key ShoppingMall: Manager Simulator – Limited Keys!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Managers!

We are pleased to announce that Steam Curator and Blogger Early Access keys are now available! If you’re a blogger, curator, or content creator interested in showcasing our game, now’s your chance to get an exclusive hands-on preview before the full release.

These keys will allow players to explore the game in advance, evaluate its features, and help us make the launch as successful as possible. Your feedback is invaluable to us!
To request a key, simply reach out to us via email at support@midnight.games. Be sure to include details about your platform or curation page, and we’ll get back to you as soon as possible.

Don't miss the chance to be the first to check out the game and share your thoughts!
See you,
The ShoppingMall: Manager Simulator Team

notes.title: ShoppingMall: Manager Simulator – Polishing the game for the perfect launch!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Managers!

We're in the final stretch! The game is almost here, and our team is fully focused on those last finishing touches. We're squashing bugs and fine-tuning every detail to make sure you get the best possible experience.

A huge thank you to our community and demo players! Your feedback has been invaluable, helping us identify and fix countless issues. Thanks to you, the game is better than ever

We're still in the final round of testing and stability checks. Join our Discord community to discuss the game, share your thoughts, and stay updated with all the latest news!

🛍️ Add ShoppingMall: Manager Simulator to your wishlist now, so you don’t miss the launch! Thanks for your continued support!

See you,
The ShoppingMall: Manager Simulator Team

notes.title: ShoppingMall: Manager Simulator – Official Launch Set for April 17!
notes.notes:
Attention future shopping empire builders! ShoppingMall: Manager Simulator is coming on April 17! 

Prepare to manage, design, and grow your own shopping mall into the hottest retail destination in town.

Customize every detail, from store selection to attracting the right crowd, while making critical business decisions that affect your mall’s success. Will your shopping center be a luxury paradise or a lively entertainment hub? You have the power to decide!

🛍️ Add ShoppingMall: Manager Simulator to your wishlist today, and be ready for the grand opening on April 17 — don’t miss out!

See you,
The ShoppingMall: Manager Simulator Team

notes.title: ShoppingMall: Manager Simulator Joins NextFest - Play the Demo & Full Version!
notes.notes:
Dear Managers,

Exciting news! ShoppingMall: Manager Simulator is officially participating in NextFest, starting February 24! This is your chance to dive into the world of mall management, whether you’re new to the game or looking to expand your empire.

What to Expect:
• Try the Free Demo - Get a taste of running your own shopping mall, making key business decisions, and managing tenants.
• Experience the Full Version - Play the complete game and see just how far you can take your business.
• Join the Community - Watch livestreams, engage with other players, and share your feedback!

Whether you’re strategizing store placements, negotiating leases, or keeping customers happy, ShoppingMall: Manager Simulator offers a deep and rewarding experience.
Mark your calendars - NextFest begins on February 24! Don’t miss this opportunity to try the game and start building your shopping empire.

Be sure to add ShoppingMall: Manager Simulator to your Wishlist to stay updated on its official release, special announcements, and exclusive discounts!
Don’t miss out on this chance to begin a unique business journey! Join us at Steam Next Fest and start shaping the ultimate shopping experience.

See you at the festival!
The ShoppingMall: Manager Simulator Team

notes.title: ShoppingMall: Manager Simulator – Play the Free Demo on February 20!
notes.notes:
Dear Future Mall Tycoons,

Exciting news! On February 20, the demo version of ShoppingMall: Manager Simulator will be released! This is your first chance to step into the world of mall management, design your shopping center, and run a successful business.

What to Expect in the Demo:

• Build & Customize - Design your shopping mall, choose store layouts, and create the perfect shopping experience.
• Manage Stores & Customers - Attract visitors, keep them happy, and watch your profits grow.
• Test Your Business Skills - Optimize your strategy to become the ultimate mall mogul.


The demo will give you a first taste of the full experience, allowing you to explore core features and get a feel for running a thriving shopping center.

Mark your calendars - February 20 is just around the corner! Try the demo, share your feedback, and help us shape the final game. Don’t forget to add the game to your WISHLIST so you don’t miss any updates!

See you in the world of retail!
The ShoppingMall: Manager Simulator Team
